A fire detection system must be installed in each designated fire zone, as defined in USAR.1181, and comply with the following:
(a) Each fire detector system must be constructed and installed to withstand the vibration, inertia and other loads and environmental stresses (salt fog, humidity, dirt, etc.) to which it may be subjected in operation.
(b) No fire detector, wiring or components may be adversely affected by any fuel, oil, water, other fluids, or fumes that might be present.
(c) There must be means to allow the UAV crew to check, in flight, the functioning of each fire detector electric circuit.
(d) The detector, wiring and other components of each fire detection system in a designated fire zone must be at least fire-resistant.
(e) The fire detection system must be designed to minimise false warnings or inappropriate warnings and if they occur shall not result in a hazardous or more serious event.
